claims.claim: Artifact-only FAILURE affinity requires validated EXECUTION failure identity, nontransportability, exact RUN/TASK/base/head lineage, readable head ancestry and matching original affinity.
Local wake freshness accepts authenticated artifact-only failures without requiring a candidate ref and retains UNRESOLVED until recognized canonical successor evidence.

Present failure candidate refs must equal the failed head; malformed identities, contradictory terminals, unauthorized missing candidates and ref races fail closed. RESULT candidate requirements remain intact.
Admission and wake fixtures share exact immutable failure selectors and original affinity; production changes remain read-only identity and freshness operations.

Existing durable inbox, lane locks, deduplication, affinity barriers and pre-click ambiguity recording are preserved, with added artifact-only duplicate, locked, deferred, ambiguous-send and cross-origin fixtures.

Artifact-only successor observation retains exact repair RUN/head/TASK checks, contiguous artifact-bound supersession checks, same-affinity TASK revision checks and final ref-currentness checks without selecting repair actions.

Added regression fixtures cover missing and present candidates, identity and route mismatches, divergent refs, opposite terminals, races and wake contention. Existing test ASTs, public signatures and workflow tests are preserved.

Committed changes reproduce the authenticated prior delta in two attention/wake modules and three permitted tests. Corrected roadmap bytes, strict YAML loader, Runtime and lifecycle authority surfaces remain unchanged.
